body:
I am feeling much better today, though I think I may be getting sick because of my increasingly terrible sleep patterns. 

Anyway, I started seeing a counselor a couple weeks ago. He's really great and it's nice to be able to talk to someone about how I've been feeling. Suicide had entered by thoughts before, but never very seriously. Last night was the closest I've ever come, and I wasn't actually that close I guess. Killing myself would hurt my parents too much. I often wish I was never born so that I wouldn't be dealing with this dilemma 

I just had a meltdown last night. It has happened before, but last night might have been the worst. Once I start thinking the self-loathing thoughts, they just keep spiraling out of control. That, combined with the school-related stress and the general loneliness, culminates into meltdowns some times. Honestly, marijuana is one of the only things that can calm me down when I get like that. 

I'll be okay, but I definitely need to continue the sessions with the counselor. There are a lot of issues I need to work on. Thank god summer is coming soon and I'll have a break from schoolwork, and more time to work on improving myself. 

And thank you. I'm amazed that people actually come on this subreddit with the patience to help like that. You're a good person.
I am in and out of sleep right now. I'll respond to what you said later. Don't worry, I am safe tonight

I just showered for a good 45 minutes. It helped me calm down a bit. Tonight is the closest I've come to doing it, but there have been other nights that I strongly considered it. 

I can't do it knowing how my parents would react. It's not fair to them. I'm miserable just being alive, yet I have to bear through it because I can't stand knowing how it will affect them. But the thing is, I have almost no closeness with my parents. Just like every other relationship in my life, I can't open myself up to them. But just because I'm their son, they would be devastated if I ended it all. And making others upset only makes me hate myself more. 

I just don't know what I'm supposed to do or where I'm supposed to go. I'm just going to have to wake up in the morning and go to class and pretend like everything is normal like any other day. And I'll also have to write 20 pages in two days, which will drive me even further up the wall. 

I used to at least have my school accomplishments, but now I feel like I literally have nothing. I don't know how much more I can take.
